parameters.help_en:
The workspace visibility. Valid values:
PRIVATE: Visible only to the creator and administrators in the workspace. This is the default value.
PUBLIC: Visible to all users in the workspace.
ROLE_PUBLIC: Visible to specified workspace roles. For the role list, refer to AccessibleRoleIdList. The dataset owner and administrators always have visibility regardless of the specified roles
parameters.help_zh:
工作空间可见度。支持以下取值：
PRIVATE（默认值）：表示工作空间内自己以及管理员可见。
PUBLIC：工作空间所有用户可见。
ROLE_PUBLIC：指定工作空间角色可见，角色列表参考：AccessibleRoleIdList。该条件下数据集所有者及管理员始终具备可见性
parameters.name: accessibility

parameters.help_en: Takes effect only when Accessibility is set to ROLE_PUBLIC. The list of workspace role names that have visibility to the dataset. Role IDs starting with PAI are basic role IDs, and those starting with role- are custom role IDs
parameters.help_zh: 在Accessibility为ROLE_PUBLIC时生效。该数据集可见的工作空间角色名列表，PAI开头的为基础角色ID，role-开头的为自定义角色ID
parameters.name: accessible_role_id_list

parameters.help_en:
The data source type. Valid values:
OSS: Alibaba Cloud Object Storage Service (OSS).
NAS: Alibaba Cloud File Storage NAS (General-purpose).
EXTREMENAS: Alibaba Cloud File Storage NAS (Extreme).
CPFS: Alibaba Cloud Cloud Paralleled File System (CPFS) (General-purpose).
BMCPFS: Alibaba Cloud Cloud Paralleled File System (CPFS) (AI-optimized). 
MAXCOMPUTE: Alibaba Cloud MaxCompute.
URL: A public HTTP or HTTPS URL
parameters.help_zh:
数据源类型。支持以下取值：
OSS：阿里云对象存储（OSS）。
NAS：阿里云文件存储（NAS）通用型。
EXTREMENAS：阿里云文件存储（NAS）极速型。
CPFS:  阿里云文件存储（CPFS）通用版。
BMCPFS：阿里云文件存储（CPFS）智算版。 
MAXCOMPUTE：阿里云云原生大数据计算服务（MaxCompute）。
URL：公网HTTP/HTTPS地址
parameters.name: data_source_type

parameters.help_en:
The dataset edition. Default value: BASIC. Valid values:
BASIC: Basic edition. Does not support file metadata management for the dataset.
ADVANCED: Advanced edition. Only OSS datasets are supported. Each version supports metadata management for up to 1 million files.
LOGICAL: Logical edition. Only OSS datasets are supported. Each version supports metadata management for up to 3 million files
parameters.help_zh:
数据集类型。默认为BASIC，支持以下取值：

BASIC：基础型。不支持数据集文件元数据管理。
ADVANCED：高级型。仅OSS类型支持，每个版本支持最多100万个文件元数据管理。
LOGICAL：逻辑型。仅OSS类型支持，每个版本支持最多300万个文件元数据管理
parameters.name: edition

parameters.help_en:
The storage import configuration of the dataset. OSS, NAS, and CPFS are supported.
OSS {
"region": "${region}",// The region ID.
"bucket": "${bucket}",// The bucket name.
"path": "${path}" // The file path.
}
NAS {
"region": "${region}",// The region ID.
"fileSystemId": "${file_system_id}", // The file system ID.
"path": "${path}", // The file system path.
"mountTarget": "${mount_target}" // The mount target of the file system.
}
CPFS {
"region": "${region}",// The region ID.
"fileSystemId": "${file_system_id}", // The file system ID.
"protocolServiceId":"${protocol_service_id}", // The protocol service of the file system.
"exportId": "${export_id}", // The export directory of the file system.
"path": "${path}", // The file system path.
}
AI-optimized CPFS {
"region": "${region}",// The region ID.
"fileSystemId": "${file_system_id}", // The file system ID.
"path": "${path}", // The file system path.
"mountTarget": "${mount_target}", // The mount target of the file system. Specific to the AI-optimized edition.
"isVpcMount": boolean, // Specifies whether the mount target is a VPC mount target. Specific to the AI-optimized edition.
}
parameters.help_zh:
数据集的存储导入配置信息，支持OSS/NAS/CPFS等。
OSS {
"region": "${region}",//地域ID
"bucket": "${bucket}",//bucket名称
"path": "${path}" //文件路径
}
NAS {
"region": "${region}",//地域ID
"fileSystemId": "${file_system_id}", //文件系统ID
"path": "${path}", //文件系统路径
"mountTarget": "${mount_target}" //文件系统挂载点
}
CPFS {
"region": "${region}",//地域ID
"fileSystemId": "${file_system_id}", //文件系统ID
"protocolServiceId":"${protocol_service_id}", //文件系统协议服务
"exportId": "${export_id}", //文件系统导出目录
"path": "${path}", //文件系统路径
}
智算CPFS {
"region": "${region}",//地域ID
"fileSystemId": "${file_system_id}", //文件系统ID
"path": "${path}", //文件系统路径
"mountTarget": "${mount_target}" //文件系统挂载点，智算版特有
"isVpcMount": boolean, //是否为vpc挂载点, 智算版特有
}

parameters.help_en:
The list of workspace role names that have read and write permissions when the dataset is mounted. Role IDs starting with PAI are basic role IDs, and those starting with role- are custom role IDs. If the list contains an asterisk (*), all roles have read and write permissions.
Specified roles: ["PAI.AlgoOperator", "role-hiuwpd01ncrokkgp21"]
All roles: ["*"]
Dataset creator only: []
parameters.help_zh:
指定该数据集被挂载时具有读写权限的工作空间角色名列表，PAI开头的为基础角色ID，role-开头的为自定义角色ID。如果列表中包含了"*"，则表示对所有角色都有读写权限。
指定角色下的账号： ["PAI.AlgoOperator", "role-hiuwpd01ncrokkgp21"]
全部账号：["*"]
指定为数据集创建者: []

parameters.help_en:
The name of the dataset. The naming rules are as follows:
The name must start with a lowercase letter, an uppercase letter, a digit, or a Chinese character.
The name can contain underscores (_) and hyphens (-).
The name must be 1 to 127 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:

以小写字母、大写字母、数字或中文开头。
可以包含下划线（_）或短划线（-）。
长度为1~127个字符

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the data source.
When SourceType is set to USER, SourceId can be customized.
When SourceType is set to ITAG, which indicates that the dataset is generated from the labeling results of the iTAG module, SourceId is the iTAG task ID.
When SourceType is set to PAI_PUBLIC_DATASET, which indicates that the dataset is created from a PAI public dataset, SourceId is empty by default
parameters.help_zh:
数据来源ID。
当SourceType为USER时，SourceId支持自定义。
当SourceType为ITAG时，即iTAG模块标注结果生成的数据集时，SourceId为ITAG的任务ID。
当SourceType为PAI_PUBLIC_DATASET时，即使用PAI公共数据集创建的数据集时，SourceId默认为空

parameters.help_en:
The URI configuration examples are as follows:
If the data source type is OSS: `oss://bucket.endpoint/object`
If the data source type is NAS:
For general-purpose NAS, the format is `nas://<nasfisid>.region/subpath/to/dir/`.
For CPFS 1.0, the format is `nas://<cpfs-fsid>.region/subpath/to/dir/`.
For CPFS 2.0, the format is `nas://<cpfs-fsid>.region/<protocolserviceid>/`.
CPFS 1.0 and CPFS 2.0 are distinguished by the format of the fsid: the format for CPFS 1.0 is cpfs-<8 ASCII characters>, and the format for CPFS 2.0 is cpfs-<16 ASCII characters>
parameters.help_zh:
Uri配置样例如下：
数据源类型为OSS：`oss://bucket.endpoint/object`
数据源类型为NAS：
通用型NAS格式为：`nas://<nasfisid>.region/subpath/to/dir/`；
CPFS1.0：`nas://<cpfs-fsid>.region/subpath/to/dir/`；
CPFS2.0：`nas://<cpfs-fsid>.region/<protocolserviceid>/`。
CPFS1.0和CPFS2.0根据fsid的格式来区分：CPFS1.0 格式为cpfs-<8位ASCII字符>；CPFS2.0 格式为cpfs-<16位ASCII字符>
parameters.name: uri
